name: Malaysia
tagline: 8 English-taught universities in Subang Jaya, Kuala Lumpur and more
summary: Five of the eight listed universities now have sourced entry, fee and programme notes: Newcastle, Heriot-Watt, Reading, Swinburne Sarawak and UTM. Starts vary by campus, from January or February to September.
watchOuts: Monash, IMU and RCSI & UCD are still outlines: their sites could not be read in this pass. Check them directly.
Reading and Newcastle add 6% SST to international tuition. Fee years differ, and no school has published 2027/28 prices for every degree.
Some degrees leave Malaysia: Newcastle's biomedical and sport degrees finish in the UK, and RCSI & UCD medicine spends 2.5 years in Dublin.
Most campuses have not published 2027 deadlines. Only UTM (February 2027) and Newcastle (16 July 2027) are dated.
